snippet.title: GIGASWORD | PC + Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist GIGASWORD: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1885930/GIGASWORD/

GIGASWORD is releasing November 13th on PC AND Consoles!

Balance the weight of the GIGASWORD, battling between brain and brawn. Solve intricate puzzles, discover covert chambers, and slash through foes as Ezra fights to reach the top of the Nestrium and recover the God Crystal within. Can he restore the world's coherency before it's too late?

To learn more about Studio Hybrid, Akupara Games and GIGASWORD visit:  
►Studio Hybrid: https://hybridgamesofficial.com/
►Akupara Games: https://linktr.ee/akuparagames
►GIGASWORD: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1885930/GIGASWORD/
